elias.desc: Elias, a lean weary man around forty with shoulder-length straight dark hair, light stubble and hollow grieving eyes, in a black suit, white shirt and thin black tie

bell.desc: Augustin Bell, an old watchmaker around seventy with a short white beard, kind sharp eyes, a jeweller's loupe on his brow, a brown waistcoat over a white shirt with rolled sleeves, a cherry-wood pipe

nero.desc: Nero, a tan-and-black German shepherd dog with a red collar

hale.desc: Inspector Hale, a tired middle-aged detective in a grey trench coat and a hat brim pulled low

marchetti.desc: Salvatore Marchetti, a huge heavy-set fishmonger mob boss around fifty with a thick neck, slicked-back black hair, a broken nose and a gold fish-scale necklace, in a blood-stained rubber apron over a dirty undershirt and rubber boots

saltmen.desc: rough dock workers in yellow oilskin coats, yellow sou'wester rain hats, grey wool sweaters and black rubber boots

malaspina.desc: Don Lucien Malaspina, a huge bald nightclub owner around fifty with a full thick black beard, heavy brows, a gold earring and gold rings, in a long dark fur coat over a purple silk shirt, holding a black cane with a silver head

switch.desc: Switch, a wiry young punk woman around twenty-eight with short cropped platinum-blonde hair shaved at the sides, a pale sharp face with freckles and a manic gap-toothed grin, brass welding goggles pushed up on her forehead, a long clean bright red railway work coat with brass buttons, a leather bandolier of rusty iron rail spikes across her chest, a steel chain whip with a hook wound around one forearm, black cargo trousers and heavy black boots

tinder.desc: Tinder, a thin bony man around thirty-five with a gaunt soot-smeared face, a shiny burn scar on his left cheek, patchy stubble, greasy dark hair, round black welder's goggles on his forehead, a scorched brown leather welder's apron over a filthy grey undershirt, a bandolier of glass bottles with rag wicks across his chest, holding a burning road flare

rats.desc: young street punks in layered dark hoodies and patched work jackets, rain-soaked beanies, scarves pulled over their mouths, patched jeans, pale soot-smeared skin
